data.name: San Diego Tours: Tijuana Culture & Culinary Tour (Daily)
data.description: Discover the vibrant heart of Baja California with our Tijuana Culture & Culinary Tour, a 5-hour immersive experience that blends the city’s colorful history, local traditions, and world-famous flavors. This guided tour takes guests beyond the border into one of Mexico’s most dynamic and artistic cities—perfect for foodies, culture lovers, and curious travelers alike.
data.highlights:
Pasaje Rodríguez – Explore this artistic alley filled with murals, indie shops, and local creatives.

Mercado Hidalgo – Wander through Tijuana’s beloved open-air market filled with vibrant colors, traditional crafts, spices, and local produce.
data.itinerary:
1:00 PM – Pick-Up in San Diego
Meet your bilingual guide and begin the drive to Tijuana.

2:00 PM – Arrival & Cultural Walk
Stroll through Pasaje Rodríguez and enjoy a guided walk through Mercado Hidalgo.

3:00 PM – Taco Tasting Tour
Stop at a selection of beloved local taquerías for a guided tasting experience.

4:00 PM – Private Tequila Tasting
Enjoy a curated tasting of tequila (and mezcal upon request) in a private setting.

5:00 PM – Return to San Diego via Fast Pass Lane for extra fee of $85
Smooth re-entry with private transportation.

6:00 PM – Drop-Off at Original Location

meeting_point.address: 4009 Taylor Street San Diego, CA US 92110

data.what_is_included:
Round-trip private transportation from San Diego

Expert bilingual local guide

Guided visit to Pasaje Rodríguez and Mercado Hidalgo

Taco tasting at multiple stops

Private tequila tasting

Access to the U.S. Fast Pass Lane (to expedite return)

Bottled water and hand sanitizer
data.what_is_not_included:
Gratuities

Additional personal purchases at the market

Border crossing documents (valid passport required)
data.cancellation_notes:
There are no refunds. All tours are subject to cancellation if we do not meet the minimum number of participants. In the event of a cancellation on our end, you will receive an email notification and a full refund will be issued via the original method of payment.

Please note:

Guests must bring a valid passport to cross the U.S.–Mexico border. Failure to bring valid documentation will result in denied entry into Mexico, and no refunds will be issued.

Thank you for your understanding.
data.booking_notes:
Thank you for booking the Tijuana Culture & Culinary Tour with us! We’re excited to take you on a delicious and culturally rich adventure in Baja California.

Your bilingual guide will meet you at your agreed pick-up location at 1:00 PM. Please be ready a few minutes before the scheduled time.

This tour includes guided visits to Pasaje Rodríguez and Mercado Hidalgo, a taco tasting, and a private tequila tasting.

Please bring a valid passport, as it is required to cross the U.S.–Mexico border.

Access to the U.S. Fast Pass Lane is included to expedite your return.

Bottled water and hand sanitizer will be provided.

Wear comfortable walking shoes and bring extra cash or a card for optional purchases at the market or along the way.

Gratuities and personal expenses are not included.

If you have dietary restrictions (e.g., vegetarian), please let us know in advance so we can accommodate you.

We look forward to sharing this flavorful journey with you!
